preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'clinlims' AND table_name = 'pathology_consultation' AND column_name IN ('id', 'pathology_sample_id', 'requested_by', 'consulted_user_id', 'reason_dictionary_id', 'pre_treatment', 'status', 'outcome', 'outcome_note', 'requested_at', 'answered_at', 'last_updated')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'clinlims' AND table_name = 'pathology_consultation'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'clinlims' AND table_name = 'pathology_consultation' AND is_nullable = 'NO' AND column_name IN ('id', 'pathology_sample_id', 'requested_by', 'consulted_user_id', 'pre_treatment', 'status', 'requested_at', 'last_updated')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE table_schema = 'clinlims' AND table_name = 'pathology_consultation' AND constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY' AND constraint_name IN ('pathology_consultation_case_fk', 'pathology_consultation_requested_by_fk', 'pathology_consultation_consulted_user_fk', 'pathology_consultation_reason_fk')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE table_schema = 'clinlims' AND table_name = 'pathology_consultation' AND constraint_type = 'CHECK' AND constraint_name IN ('pathology_consultation_status_ck', 'pathology_consultation_outcome_ck', 'pathology_consultation_outcome_answered_ck')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'clinlims' AND tablename = 'pathology_consultation' AND indexname IN ('idx_pathology_consultation_case', 'pathology_consultation_awaited_uk')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'clinlims' AND indexname = 'pathology_consultation_awaited_uk' AND indexdef LIKE 'CREATE UNIQUE INDEX%' AND indexdef LIKE '%REQUESTED%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.sequences WHERE sequence_schema = 'clinlims' AND sequence_name = 'pathology_consultation_seq'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.reference_tables WHERE name = 'PATHOLOGY_CONSULTATION' AND keep_history = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.dictionary_category WHERE name = 'pathology_consultation_reasons' AND local_abbrev = 'PathConsRs' AND description = 'Pathology - Second Opinion Reasons'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.pathology_sample WHERE id = 990501 AND status = 'UNDER_REVIEW'
